Nested ordered list with two levels of depth

```swift title="Swift"

let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<ol><li>Step 1<ol><li>Step 1a</li><li>Step 1b</li></ol></li><li>Step 2</li></ol>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
